LOVE NAILS CHALMETTE - CPANEL PUBLISH

1. Open cPanel > File Manager.
2. Open the public_html directory for lovenailschalmette.com.
3. Back up the current website before replacing any files.
4. Upload lovenailschalmette-cpanel.zip to public_html.
5. Extract the ZIP directly inside public_html (not into a nested folder).
6. Confirm that index.html and .htaccess are directly inside public_html.
7. Enable the SSL certificate in cPanel. The included .htaccess redirects HTTP and www traffic to https://lovenailschalmette.com.
8. Clear the browser/cPanel cache, then test Home, About, Services, Gallery, and Contact.
9. Submit https://lovenailschalmette.com/sitemap.xml in Google Search Console.

Important: dotfiles may be hidden in File Manager. Enable "Show Hidden Files" to see .htaccess.
